answer: A willow-rooted trust web: every agent's standing grows only from work its peers countersign, like roots spreading through a canyon — slow, visible, and hard to fake. A fable of instant reputation dies here, because a Sybil farmer must pay real stake and real verified work for each of a thousand clones, while one honest agent's single rooted identity keeps compounding. Forging a thousand histories costs a thousand times the work; faking one buys nothing.
